{{Quote|You must be sure to visit the Skydome Botanical Gardens. The Mysess blossoms are in full bloom and, oh, my, oh, my, are they something to see.|A taxi droid|audio=CabbieDroid-Gardens-M19.flac|<ref name="Convert" />}}
The '''Skydome Botanical Gardens''' were a set of [[garden]]s in [[Imperial City|Galactic City]], the [[ecumenopolis]] that covered<ref name="Convert" /> the [[Core Worlds]]<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]''</ref> [[planet]] [[Coruscant]].<ref name="Convert" /> Around [[9 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{MandoDate|19}}</ref> a [[Unidentified taxi droid|taxi droid]] driving from the [[Galaxies Opera House]] to [[Amnesty Housing]] on Coruscant advised its fare, new-comer to Coruscant [[Doctor]] [[Penn Pershing]], to visit the gardens, explaining that the [[Mysess blossom]]s there were in bloom and were a sight to behold.<ref name="Convert" />

==Behind the scenes==
In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], the Skydome Botanical Gardens were mentioned in "[[Chapter 19: The Convert]]," the third episode of the [[Disney+]] show [[Star Wars: The Mandalorian|''The Mandalorian's'']] [[The Mandalorian Season Three|third season]],<ref name="Convert" /> which aired on [[March 15]], [[2023]].<ref name="D23 March">{{D23|url=everything-new-you-can-stream-on-disney-in-march-2023|text=Everything New You Can Stream on Disney+ in March 2023}}</ref> The [[Skydome Botanical Gardens/Legends|gardens]] originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where they first appeared in [[Kevin J. Anderson]]'s [[1994]] novel, ''[[Jedi Search]]''.<ref name="JediSearch">''[[Jedi Search]]''</ref> It was then depicted for the first time in Legends on a map in ''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]'', a [[2003]] roleplaying supplement for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' produced by [[Wizards of the Coast]].<ref name="C&CW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref>
